stem.text: The partial pressure of oxygen in air inside alveoli is $14\,\text{kPa}$.
The partial pressure of oxygen in pulmonary capillaries is $6\,\text{kPa}$.
What will be the effect of these partial pressures on diffusion?

A.text: Carbon dioxide will not diffuse in any direction.

B.text: Oxygen will diffuse from alveoli into capillaries.

C.text: Oxygen will diffuse from capillaries into alveoli.

D.text: Oxygen will diffuse equally in both directions.
